author_direction.author: Kirk LaSalle
author_direction.statement: Candidate A, all options 1, 2, and 3 can be tested. Run the gamut.
author_direction.scope: Authorize investigation of all three operationalizations, with the full density-law route for option 3. This is not selection of a single final theory or approval of an observational result.

registration_scope: Prospective local numerical protocol for new consistency and solver checks and reproduction of the old observational test. NOT a new blind observational preregistration. Frozen before running the new diagnostic suite.
prior_knowledge: The option-2 SPARC result and every galaxy in it are already known.
The GR projection identity, its unique exponent alpha=1, and the nonlinearity of powers are known algebra.

Before this freeze the official SPARC website and CDS J/AJ/136/2782 ReadMe were inspected, Leroy tables were downloaded, and completeness was counted. All 11 overlaps with the certified SPARC primary sample have at least one missing density component. No option-3 prediction or fit was computed.
The new tables are projected surface densities, not direct three-dimensional densities; neither source supplies a complete vertical reconstruction.

option_1.definition: C_m=(G_mu_nu+Lambda*g_mu_nu)n^mu n^nu, M=T_mu_nu n^mu n^nu/c^2, alpha=1, k=c^2*C0/(8*pi*G). M excludes local gravitational field energy; Lambda remains on the geometric side.
option_1.tests: Dust, radiation and vacuum-energy fluid with p/epsilon in {0,1/3,-1}, observer beta in {0,0.3,0.9}, epsilon in {1e-10,1,1e10} J/m^3 and C0 in {1e-50,1e-20,1e-5} m^-2. Check the projected tensor equation, unit normalization, and mapping at rtol=1e-12. Check Schwarzschild exterior and Lambda vacuum separately through existing diagnostics.
option_1.limits: Conditional consistency tests, not an empirical discrimination from GR and not proof of full tensor dynamical equivalence.

option_2.action: Rerun every old primary, Q3 and sensitivity treatment without modifying the old protocol, evaluator or artifact. Compare all scientific result fields, including per-galaxy output, to the old artifact at rtol=1e-8 and atol=1e-8 for floats; integers and labels exactly. Exclude only revision and environment from the comparison.
option_2.interpretation: Authorization to investigate option 2 is now explicit. Preserve its original assistant-proposed status as historical provenance, not the current authorization state. Reproduction is not another independent observational test.

option_3.weak_field_source: rho_eff = rho0*(rho_bar/rho0)^(1/alpha); laplacian(Phi)=4*pi*G*rho_eff; Phi->0 at infinity for integrable isolated sources
option_3.circular_velocity: V_c^2(R)=R*dPhi(R,z=0)/dR, computed from the full source density, not a power of V_bar or acceleration
option_3.density_order: Add stellar, atomic-gas and molecular-gas volume densities before the nonlinear map. Gas columns from Leroy already include helium; never apply a second helium factor.
option_3.normalization: rho0 is a physical density scale when alpha != 1, not an arbitrary unit conversion. It is unidentifiable when alpha=1. No empirical value or fitted range is selected by this diagnostic protocol.
option_3.gr_gate: With ordinary GR sourced ONLY by the same baryons, rho_eff=rho_bar over varying positive density requires alpha=1. A nonunit exponent therefore needs an additional effective stress-energy source or modified dynamics; the scalar density relation alone does not supply a covariant conserved theory.
tests: alpha in {0.25,0.5,1,2,4}, rho_bar/rho0 in {0,0.01,0.1,1,10,100}: inversion, alpha=1 nesting, vacuum limit, crossing of rho_eff-rho_bar about rho0, and non-additivity for alpha != 1

Finite-thickness axisymmetric Poisson solver using analytic azimuthal elliptic-integral kernel and positive-z Gauss-Legendre quadrature, reflected about the midplane. No force softening or spherical substitution.

Analytic Miyamoto-Nagai density/potential benchmark: mass=1, radial scale=1, height=0.2, G=1; radii={0.5,1,2,4}; integrate R' and z from zero to infinity via rational coordinate maps; split radial quadrature at each field radius.

Solver benchmark at quadrature orders 64 and 128 per radial segment and vertical integral; maximum relative V_c^2 error <0.005 against the analytic potential, and coarse/fine disagreement <0.005. These are software thresholds, not statistical evidence.

Full-density nonlinear shape check on a separate positive double-exponential disc rho_bar=exp(-R)*exp(-abs(z)/0.2) at alpha in {0.5,1,2}, rho0=1 and radii={0.5,1,2,4}: order 64 versus 128 agreement <0.005. This source remains integrable for every tested exponent. Values are mathematical examples, not galaxies.

data_gate.audit: Every overlap of Leroy table4/table7 with the certified SPARC primary sample, normalized by removing spaces from galaxy identifiers. Report counts of missing, nonpositive-radius, negative, and upper-limit-flagged components using documented fixed-width fields.
requirements_before_fit: Explicit, justified 3-D stellar, HI, H2 and bulge reconstruction including scale heights, distance/inclination alignment, unresolved inner source and outer boundary or extrapolation
Treatment of missing measurements, censored gas limits, stellar mass-to-light and CO conversion uncertainties, without zero-filling missing values
A declared covariant completion or an explicit restriction to a phenomenological weak-field source law

A new frozen observational protocol specifying global versus local alpha and rho0, bounds, nuisance treatments, sample selection, numerical tolerances, comparator, decision statistic and calibration limits
data_gate.failure_outcome: blocked_pending_density_reconstruction_and_observational_protocol; do not fit, compute a p-value, or label option 3 empirically rejected or supported

new_data.redistribution: Keep downloaded source tables in the ignored external-data cache; cite the source. No open-source data licence is asserted.

reporting.input_or_numerical_failure: incomplete with an explicit reason and nonzero exit status; no success-shaped fallback
reporting.scientific_gate_failure: Report the failed gate, preserve completed checks, and exit nonzero. A passed software check never overrides a missing physical or data assumption.
reporting.frozen_files: Never rewrite earlier preregistrations or result artifacts to make authorization, reproducibility or scientific outcomes appear different.
